title: authentik
description: An open-source Identity Provider emphasizing flexibility and versatility. Integrates easily into existing environments with SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, and LDAP support.
features: Supports modern SSO protocols: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, and LDAP
Visual flow and stage builder for customized authentication, enrollment, and password recovery
Embedded outpost proxies for forward authentication protecting legacy web services
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) with WebAuthn, FIDO2, TOTP, and SMS
User directory synchronization from Google Workspace, Active Directory, and Azure AD
pros: Replaces expensive enterprise identity solutions like Okta and Auth0
Complete control over identity data and security compliance
Extremely flexible policy engine written in Python
cons: Initial deployment and flow setup has a moderate learning curve
Requires PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker hosting resources
targetAudience: DevOps teams, self-hosters, and companies wanting self-managed enterprise SSO.
